entities.summary: Argenis Alexander Méndez Zapata is a Dominican former professional boxer who held the International Boxing Federation super-featherweight title from 2013 to 2014. As an amateur, he won the featherweight silver medal at the Junior World Championships in 2004, as well as the gold medal in the same division at the 2005 Pan American Championship.
